name: io.github.proplineapi/propline-mcp
title: PropLine — Sports Betting Odds & Prop Resolution
description: Live player props betting odds, cross-book +EV, prop resolution (every Over/Under graded against real box scores), scores, and box-score stats across MLB, NBA, NHL, NFL, soccer, UFC and 13 sportsbooks. The-odds-api compatible.

environmentVariables.name: PROPLINE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: PropLine API key. Free tier (1,000 req/day, no card) at https://prop-line.com

environmentVariables.name: PROPLINE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API origin (default https://api.prop-line.com). For self-hosted setups only.
